fixes.correction: Reverse the camera and keep Nagoji standing. The view is from behind and slightly beside Ramayyan, over his shoulder. In the near foreground we see the back of his head (receding hair, curly dark fringe at the nape) and the plain white cloth over his shoulder. He sits cross-legged on his low seat, both hands resting on his knees well away from the table, and his head tips in a small nod toward the empty stool. Across the low table, Nagoji STANDS just inside the open wooden door with rain falling beyond it, facing the camera with his face clearly visible. He is in the same wet uniform as the previous panel: white European-cut coat, red waistcoat, brass buttons, knee breeches, buckled riding boots, silver chain of office, topknot, grey at the temples, thick curled moustache, clean-shaven chin, small gold ear stud. Water drips from his coat to the floor. The single low stool stands EMPTY between him and the table. On the table, a single blank palm leaf lies flat, weighted with a small smooth river stone, with no writing visible. Keep the same whitewashed laterite room. Seen from this side, the lamp niche is on the side wall at the LEFT of the frame. Leave a band of plain whitewashed wall across the top of the frame, clear of both heads, for one balloon.
fixes.issues: The only candidate gets the beat and the framing wrong. Nagoji is already SEATED on the stool while Ramayyan's line is 'Sit.', and panel 1.4 is where he first sits ('Nagoji now on the stool'). The camera is also reversed: we look over NAGOJI's shoulder, so his face is hidden and Ramayyan faces us, when the script asks for a view over RAMAYYAN's shoulder. The room, the leaf under the stone and Ramayyan's hands on his knees are all correct.

fixes.correction: Keep this composition exactly. It is a two-shot across the low table. Nagoji sits on the low stool at left in the wet white European-cut coat, red waistcoat, brass buttons, knee breeches and buckled boots, water dripping to the wet floor. Ramayyan sits cross-legged at right, lifting the small river stone between finger and thumb. Keep the same room: the open door with rain, the barred window with the neem tree, the lamp in its niche. Fix the forearm: Nagoji's coat sleeves come all the way down to his wrists and stay down, so no forearm skin shows. There is NO tattoo, NO symbol, NO monogram or letter-like mark and NO pink or red line anywhere on his skin. Put a single blank palm leaf (the one the stone weighted in the previous panel) flat on the table in front of Ramayyan, with no writing visible. The silver chain of office ends in a plain round silver medallion with no crown, cross or emblem. Keep the plain upper wall between Nagoji's head and the window, and the wall right of the window above the lamp niche, clear for three balloons.
fixes.issues: The composition, the room, the dripping coat and Ramayyan lifting the stone are all good. However, Nagoji's coat sleeve is pushed above the elbow, and his bare inner left forearm shows two problems. The brand is a crisp black tattoo-like monogram glyph, which reads as letters or pseudo-text. The scar is a bright pink-red line that reads as a fresh wound. The bible wants a pale, puckered, shapeless patch and a WHITE old scar, and the art must contain no letter-like marks. A smaller point: the medallion on the chain has a crown-like crest. The single leaf from panel 1.3 is missing from the table.

fixes.correction: Turn the procession around so it plainly leaves the city. Show the column side-on and at a distance, riding from the right toward the left edge of the frame. Put the Tiruchirappalli ramparts, square towers, gate and great granite rock behind them on the right, receding, so that no rider heads toward or into the gate and the captive is clearly being taken away. Every captor is a Maratha horseman in a white or cream angarkha and a white or cream pagdi with plain cross-belts. Draw no checked or quilted coats and no dark indigo or black turbans anywhere in the column, because that is the look of Chanda Sahib's own riders and makes the escort read as his men. Keep what worked: Chanda Sahib, heavy-built in his white Mughal jama and high cream turban, mounted in the middle of the column with his wrists chained and riders close on every side, his face turned away or too small to read; saffron swallow-tailed pennants on lances; cool, dusty daylight; and the broad clear sky in the upper third for the two captions.
fixes.issues: The prominent foreground captors wear checked quilted coats and dark indigo turbans. That is the bible's look for Chanda Sahib's own riders, not the Maratha white or cream angarkhas and pagdis the scoped deccan rule requires. The column also rides toward and into the city gate instead of away from the walls. Together these make the panel read as Chanda Sahib being escorted into Tiruchirappalli by his own men. What works: the captive in a white jama and cream turban with chained wrists and no readable face, the saffron swallow-tailed pennants, the rock and ramparts, the cool dusty light, and the clear sky for captions.

fixes.correction: Make this a true CLOSE-UP, not a medium shot. Show Nagoji's head and shoulders only, his face filling the left-centre of the frame at about half the frame height, in three-quarter view turned toward the viewer's right, where Ramayyan sits off-panel. His eyes are narrowed and wary, brow slightly furrowed. Keep the face exactly as in the previous attempt: thick curled moustache, CLEAN-SHAVEN chin, small gold ear stud, grey at the temples, Kerala topknot. Show the white coat collar, white stock, red waistcoat and silver chain of office at the bottom edge. Keep both forearms and hands out of frame, so no brand or scar is shown. Behind him show only the dark wooden plank door with its iron ring and the whitewashed laterite wall beside it (the door stands behind his stool, as in 3.1), lit warm from one side by the niche lamp. Do NOT show the table, Ramayyan's seat, or any bench, daybed, cushion or bolster, so the room never reads as empty of Ramayyan. Leave clear plain wall above and to the right of his head for two balloons.
fixes.issues: v01 is a medium shot, not the scripted 'close on Nagoji'. It also shows Ramayyan's place in the room (back wall, right of the window, under the lamp niche) as an empty carved daybed with a red bolster. That is different furniture from his low mat seat in 3.1, and it makes him look as if he has left, which contradicts the off-panel line and 3.3. The wide framing also exposes the forearm brand, drawn as a dark boxed grid that reads as a stamped glyph rather than the bible's pale puckered patch. Nagoji's face itself is on model (moustache, clean chin, stud, grey temples).

fixes.correction: Keep Ramayyan's face and plain white cloth, the barred, unglazed window directly behind him with the neem bowed and streaming in the rain, and the lamp niche on the side wall at the viewer's left. Stage him exactly as in panels 1.2 to 3.1: sitting CROSS-LEGGED on the same low wooden platform seat with its woven mat against the back wall. NO chair, no armchair, no legs hanging down. The low dark wooden table stands in front of him with the tied palm-leaf bundles on it. He leans his back against the wall beneath the window, relaxed, hands resting lightly on his knees, his gaze level toward the viewer, where Nagoji sits off-panel across the table. The camera stands at Nagoji's stool, so the stool and the door are NOT in frame and no empty seat appears anywhere. Leave clear plain whitewashed wall beside the window and above his head for two balloons.
fixes.issues: In v01 Ramayyan sits upright in a wooden armchair with his legs down, beside the table rather than behind it. That breaks the cross-legged low seat used in 1.2 through 3.1. Nagoji's rush stool also sits empty in the right foreground with the door behind it, so Nagoji appears to have left the room mid-conversation. What works: the face is on model, his hands rest on his knees, the barred window and neem in rain are behind him, and the lamp niche is on the side wall to his right.

fixes.correction: Show Ramayyan alone in a medium close-up from Nagoji's side of the low table, framed so that no stool appears anywhere in the panel. He leans forward over the table into the warm light of the clay oil lamp in the wall niche on his right. Both thin hands rest flat on the table near a single palm leaf weighted by a small river stone. He holds no stylus and writes in no bundle. His eyes are narrowed and sharp, looking straight at the viewer (Nagoji, off-panel). Keep v01's face, receding curly black hair, plain white cloth, whitewashed laterite walls, and the unglazed barred window behind him with the neem bowed in grey rain. Leave the plain wall above and beside his head clear for one balloon.
fixes.issues: v01: Ramayyan's face, receding curly hair and white cloth match his sheet, and the room fits the floor plan (barred window with rain behind him, lamp niche to his right, door behind the stool). Two problems rule it out. First, Nagoji's stool sits EMPTY in the right foreground. From 1.4 onward Nagoji is seated on it, so the panel reads as if he has left while Ramayyan says 'This is the test, Ananthan.' Second, the beat is wrong: Ramayyan is busy writing in a palm-leaf bundle with a stylus and glancing sideways. The script has him leaning forward into the lamplight and addressing Nagoji, with his hands free for the leaf-and-stylus handover in 5.3.

fixes.correction: Make this a close-up, head and shoulders only, of Nagoji on his stool, facing Ramayyan just off-panel. The small flame of the niche oil lamp shows as a tiny point of light in each eye, and the side of his face is lit warm. Behind him show only the door wall of whitewashed laterite. Do not put the barred window behind him: it is behind Ramayyan. Leave plain wall above and beside his head for two balloons. Keep v01's face, Kerala topknot with grey at the temples, thick curled moustache, small gold ear stud, white European coat, red waistcoat, brass buttons and silver chain of office. His chin and jaw are smooth and clean-shaven, with no stubble. No hand is raised to his face, and both coat sleeves stay down, so no forearm, brand, scar or mark is visible.
fixes.issues: v01: The face, topknot, grey temples, curled moustache, gold ear stud and uniform match, but three things fail. (1) The brand is wrong: his raised left forearm shows a crisp circular stamp with a letter-like monogram near the ELBOW. That is pseudo-text, not a puckered patch a hand's width above the wrist. The long scar is drawn as a cross-stitched wound. (2) Visible stubble covers the chin and jaw, but the bible requires a clean-shaven chin outside captivity. (3) The shot is a medium shot with his hand on his chin, not the scripted close-up with the lamp flame in his eyes. The barred window also sits behind Nagoji, which breaks the room's floor plan, where the window is behind Ramayyan.

fixes.correction: The brand must NOT be a cross, a symbol or any crisp shape. On the inner, palm-side LEFT forearm, a hand's width above the wrist, draw a pale, puckered, irregular patch of raised scar ridges blurred past reading, with no letters, no numerals and no outline. Beside it, a long, thin white scar runs along the forearm from the wrist toward the elbow, not around the wrist. Turn the left forearm palm-up so the inner forearm faces the viewer while the left hand cradles the blank palm leaf in the palm-leaf writer's grip. Keep from v01 the right fist gripping the iron stylus like a sword hilt with healed but ridged nails, the white coat cuff slid back, the red waistcoat and silver chain, the table, and the room with its barred window and lamp niche. Draw five well-formed fingers on each hand. Leave the plain wall at upper right clear for the caption.
fixes.issues: v01: The brand on the left forearm is drawn as a clear CROSS, which the bible explicitly forbids. The 'long scar' is a cut ringing the wrist rather than a thin line running from the wrist toward the elbow. The rest works: the right fist grips the iron stylus like a sword hilt, the left hand holds the blank leaf, the white cuff is pushed back, the uniform and chain are right, and the room matches.

fixes.correction: Padmini must match her sheet: a sturdy, heavy-set woman in her fifties with a broad, stern, square-jawed face, thick curly black hair coiled at the nape (no grey yet), and no bindi or forehead mark. She wears simple gold earrings, a gold bead necklace and a cream sari with a narrow gold border in the old Kerala drape with no blouse. She is not a slim young woman. The young man receiving the brass cup is young Nagoji seen from behind, with long, curly black hair loose to the shoulders. At the table, both coat sleeves of Nagoji's uniform reach the wrist, so no brand, scar or mark shows on either hand or forearm. His left hand holds a single blank palm leaf while his right hand moves the iron stylus across it. Keep everything else from v01: the smoke-edged montage, the bangled hands tying the black thread, the drowning hand by the rope in the storm sea, the spyglass boy on the palm-top platform, Nagoji's face, topknot and uniform, the room with its barred window and lamp niche, and the plain lower wall left clear for the caption.
fixes.issues: v01: The montage structure works: the bangled, turmeric-stained hands tying a black thread, Padmini with a brass cup under the jackfruit tree, a drowning hand by a rope in a storm sea, and the spyglass boy on a palm platform, all flowing as smoke from the lamplight. Nagoji's face (clean chin, stud, topknot, grey temples) and uniform are correct. The only face in the montage fails: Padmini is drawn as a slim, smiling woman of about thirty-five with a red bindi, nothing like her sheet's stout, stern, square-jawed woman in her fifties. Also, with his hands palm-down on the table, a dark, tattoo-like symbol shows on the OUTER left forearm. The brand belongs on the inner forearm as a blurred, puckered patch. The young man taking the cup has short straight hair and does not read as young Nagoji.

fixes.correction: Swap the roles: NAGOJI is the one writing. Pull Nagoji on his stool up to the near (left) side of the low table, with the door behind him. He leans over the table, his RIGHT hand gripping the iron stylus and scoring a palm leaf, his LEFT hand flat on the leaf to steady it, eyes down on the work. RAMAYYAN sits opposite on his low wooden seat, motionless, with nothing in his hands (no stylus, no leaf) and his hands resting still on his knees. He watches Nagoji in silence. Keep the room exactly as drawn (whitewashed walls, door at left, barred window with rain and the neem tree, oil lamp in the wall niche). Keep Nagoji's white coat, red waistcoat, silver chain, topknot with grey temples, small gold ear stud, thick curled moustache and clean-shaven chin. Keep the sun-hard Colachel inset in the upper corner as drawn. On Nagoji's inner LEFT forearm show only the long pale healed scar and the brand as a pale, puckered, raised patch lighter than the skin, blurred past reading: no dark ink, no tattoo, no cross or symbol shape. Leave the palm leaves blank, with no marks that look like script.
fixes.issues: v01 reverses the script beat: Ramayyan holds the stylus and writes, while Nagoji sits back on his stool, away from the table, with his chin on his hand. The script says Nagoji writes and Ramayyan sits motionless, and the caption is in Nagoji's voice ('I wrote of Colachel'). The brand on Nagoji's forearm is also a dark tattoo shaped like a cross, which the bible forbids ('not a cross', pale puckered patch). What works: the room layout (door left, barred rain window with neem, lamp niche), Nagoji's uniform, chain, topknot, ear stud and clean chin, Ramayyan's likeness, and the Colachel inset with blue-coat VOC infantry at the waterline and Nair foot and horse closing from both flanks under plain flags.

fixes.correction: Keep this composition exactly: the full-width room, Nagoji seated facing the viewer at the table with his forearms flat on it and hands loosely clasped, the door at left, the barred rain window with the neem, the lamp niche at right, and the broad plain wall left free for lettering. Make his gaze level and straight ahead, calm and firm. Fix the forearms. His RIGHT forearm is bare, clean and unmarked: no red line, cut, wound, cord or thread of any kind. His LEFT inner forearm carries only the long healed scar, drawn pale white (not red or pink), and the brand, drawn as a pale, puckered, raised patch lighter than the surrounding skin and blurred past reading. The brand has no dark ink, no tattoo look, no letter-like or symbol shape and no cross. There is no red anywhere on his skin. The palm-leaf bundles are plain, with no marks that look like writing.
fixes.issues: A glossy fresh-looking red line crosses Nagoji's RIGHT forearm and reads as an open cut or blood, and the bible gives him no mark on that arm. On the left forearm the scar is drawn red instead of pale white. The brand is a dark brown ink glyph shaped like a curled letter, which risks pseudo-text and contradicts the pale puckered patch. The right-hand leaf bundle also has faint dashes that look like script. The face, uniform, room, framing and lettering space (plain wall at upper right) are all good.

fixes.correction: Frame this as a TIGHT INSERT of hands on the table top only: no faces, no heads, no shoulders in frame, camera low and close over the dark worn wooden table. Keep the screen direction of 7.1 and 7.3. Ramayyan's thin bare wrist and long fingers, with the edge of his plain white cloth, enter from the RIGHT edge and reach for a single tied palm-leaf bundle lying on the table. Nagoji's broader, darker hand with ridged nails enters from the LEFT edge, the white coat cuff with one plain brass button at the frame edge, and comes down flat over the back of Ramayyan's hand, pinning it to the leaves. Exactly two hands, five fingers each, clearly separated and anatomically sound. Warm oil-lamp light from screen right, same wood and palette as the neighbouring panels. The leaves are plain and unmarked. Leave plain dim table top or shadow in the upper third for one short balloon.
fixes.issues: The script asks for a tight insert of hands, but this is a medium two-shot with both faces. The staging also flips the room: Ramayyan is on the left and Nagoji on the right, both apparently on the same side of the table, which breaks the axis of 7.1 and 7.3 (Nagoji left on the door side, Ramayyan right by the lamp niche). The hands themselves (Nagoji's broad hand with brass-button cuff pinning Ramayyan's thin hand to the leaves) are good.

fixes.correction: Make this a CLOSE-UP of Nagoji's head and upper chest only. He is seated on his stool on the door side of the table, the same seat as in 7.1 and 7.3, facing screen right toward Ramayyan, who is off-panel. Behind him: plain plastered wall and the edge of the dark wooden door at the left edge. No lamp niche, no cushioned bench and no window behind him. Warm lamplight falls on his face from screen right. The expression is calm and level, mouth closed, eyes steady: quiet certainty, nothing theatrical, no frown or anger. Keep the uniform as drawn: white coat, red waistcoat, plain brass buttons, silver chain over the coat. Keep the Kerala topknot with first grey at the temples, the thick curled moustache, a smooth clean-shaven chin with no stubble, and the small gold ear stud. Keep both forearms out of frame. Leave plain low-detail wall in the upper left third, behind his head, for two short balloons.
fixes.issues: Three failures. (1) The framing is a medium-wide seated figure with a table and stool, not a close-up. (2) The room is mirrored and Nagoji sits in Ramayyan's place: lamp niche left, door right, a cushioned bench against the back wall under the window, and an empty stool in the foreground. (3) The brand on his left forearm is a dark symbol shaped like a letter or zodiac sign. The bible requires a pale puckered blurred patch with no letter shapes, so it also counts as pseudo-text. His face, uniform, ear stud and moustache match.

fixes.correction: Keep this exact composition, room, lighting and staging. Door and empty rush stool at left, barred window with rain outside, Ramayyan seated behind at the low table, Nagoji in uniform standing at the lit lamp niche in the right side wall. Fix the leaves: both palm leaves must be completely blank, flat, smooth tan strips with no lines, scratches, marks, glyphs or script of any kind on either face, and not folded. Hold them in his hands with their tips a finger's width from the open flame of the brass oil lamp. Nagoji's chin and jaw are smooth and clean-shaven with no stubble texture; only the thick curled moustache, the small gold ear stud, the topknot and the grey at the temples. Ramayyan's hands are empty, resting on his knees, with no stylus. He has turned on his seat toward Nagoji's back, watching him. Keep the plain wall between the window and Nagoji's head clear for one balloon.
fixes.issues: The composition, room and staging are right: door and Nagoji's empty stool at left, barred window, Ramayyan seated behind at the table watching, Nagoji standing at the lit niche on the right side wall holding two leaves near the flame. But both leaves carry rows of scratched script-like glyphs, which is pseudo-text in the art. Smaller points: the leaves are folded like paper troughs, Nagoji has noticeable stubble stippling across his jaw and chin, and Ramayyan holds a stylus as if writing instead of simply turning to watch.

fixes.correction: Draw ONE single image that fills the entire frame: a tight close-up of Nagoji's head and shoulders in strict profile, facing frame RIGHT toward the lamp niche in the side wall (as in 7.5), his eyes on the small open flame of the clay lamp at the right edge. The tips of the two palm leaves are in his fingers at the bottom right edge, just touching the flame's glow. Keep what worked in the earlier inset: warm lamplight on the cheekbone, thick curled moustache, a tiny flush gold stud on the lobe, grey at the temples, the Kerala topknot, the white coat collar and the silver chain. The chin and jaw are perfectly clean-shaven with no stubble. Leave the upper-left area as warm, softly shadowed plain whitewash for one balloon. NO inset, NO picture-in-picture, NO border or frame line, NO wide shot of the room and NO seated figure.
fixes.issues: v01 is not the panel the script asks for. It is a wide room shot with a small profile inset painted into its top-left corner, framed by a painted border. The main figure shows Nagoji sitting at the table with his chin on his hand. That contradicts 7.5 and 8.2, where he stands at the side-wall lamp niche holding the two leaves, and the leaves are absent from the frame. The inset profile itself is right: moustache, flush gold stud, grey temples, eyes on the flame. But it is only about 400x290 px, too small to crop and print at 300 DPI, and its chin shows visible stubble.

fixes.correction: Restage the burning at the lamp niche in the side wall, exactly where Nagoji stood in 7.5. Nagoji stands at the niche holding only TWO single palm leaves (not bundles), their tips in the small open flame of the clay lamp. The dry leaves crack and curl, a small tongue of flame runs up them, and a thread of black smoke climbs the whitewash above the niche. There is NO fire on the table and NO pile of burning bundles. The low table and its palm-leaf bundles sit untouched and unburnt in the background. Ramayyan stands a pace behind Nagoji's shoulder with his hands empty and lowered (no stylus, no ledger), both men's faces lit warm orange by the leaf flame. The barred window shows a grey, rainy afternoon with the neem in the rain, matching the neighbouring panels. Keep Nagoji's white coat, red waistcoat, silver chain, topknot with grey temples, clean chin and the scar on the inner left forearm, and keep Ramayyan's thin face, receding curly hair and plain white cloth.
fixes.issues: The burning is staged wrongly. Instead of the two leaves catching at the niche lamp, a large bonfire burns on the wooden table and consumes a whole heap of palm-leaf bundles, which reads as burning the archive. Meanwhile the niche lamp sits unused in the background. The barred window shows a clear sunny day, not the grey rain of 7.5, 8.3, 8.4 and 9.1. Ramayyan stands by the door with his ledger and stylus raised as if taking notes, and his face is barely lit by the flame. Both likenesses and Nagoji's uniform, topknot, chain and left-forearm scar are good.

fixes.correction: Keep this exact low-angle floor-level composition, the buckled boots and white breeches, the door, the rainy barred window, the seat and table and the lit niche on the right wall. Remove the gravel heap at the doorway completely: no pebbles, grit, rubble, dust piles or plaster. Instead, show a few fine, papery flakes of grey-black palm-leaf ash, some still curled into thin scrolls and one with a faint orange edge, drifting down through the air in the foreground. A light scatter of the same flakes settles on the dark flagstones just in front of and between Nagoji's boots, below the niche. Keep the upper wall area (above the door and between the window and the boots) plain and low-detail for two balloons.
fixes.issues: The low floor-level angle, the buckled boots, the room plan (door left, rainy barred window, seat and table, niche on the right wall) and the lighting all match. But the key beat, grey ash drifting down, is not shown. Nothing falls through the air. The foreground holds a heap of grey gravel, pebbles and grit piled at the doorway, which reads as rubble or plaster dust rather than the ash of two burnt palm leaves. It is also far from the niche, where the leaves burned.

fixes.correction: Show Ramayyan standing a pace from the lamp niche in the side wall, as in 8.2, his hands empty and loosely lowered, with NO stylus and NO ledger in hand. He is turned three-quarters toward the niche, eyes lifted and fixed on the last tiny orange spark on a curl of black palm-leaf ash on the niche ledge beside the clay lamp, a thin thread of grey smoke still hanging. His smile is open and genuine: lips softly parted (not baring teeth), cheeks lifted, the outer corners of his eyes crinkled, brows slightly raised as if the smile has surprised him. It must not be a smirk, a sly or knowing look, or downcast eyes. Keep his thin face, receding curly hair and plain white cloth, the rainy barred window and the table of untouched bundles behind him, and leave the upper wall to the side away from his face plain and low-detail for two captions.
fixes.issues: Ramayyan's likeness, the room plan and the rainy light are good. But he is not watching the last spark die: no spark, ash or smoke appears in the frame. He sits looking down at a palm-leaf bundle with his stylus poised, as if about to write, which jumps ahead to the 9.2 entry. His closed-lipped smile with half-lidded, downcast eyes reads as a knowing, self-satisfied bookkeeper's smile. That is close to the thin, dry smiles the script says this one must not resemble, not an open smile that reaches the eyes and is a little surprised at itself.

fixes.correction: Ramayyan, seated cross-legged on his low seat behind the table, holds the single small fresh palm leaf up in his right hand between thumb and fingers, at chest height, turning its face outward toward Nagoji so Nagoji can see it. The leaf shows only two faint scored strokes and no script. His stylus lies on the table and he is not holding any bundle. Nagoji sits on his low backless wooden stool across the table with both hands empty, resting on his knees, leaning slightly forward and looking at the leaf. He holds nothing. Keep his white coat sleeves down to the wrists so no forearm brand or scar shows. If any forearm skin does show, the brand is only a pale puckered patch of blurred ridges, with no circle, wheel, cross or symbol. His ear ornament is a tiny flush gold stud on the lobe with nothing hanging from it. Keep everything else from this version: the two-shot composition, the closed door with its iron ring behind Nagoji, the barred window with rain and the neem tree, the lit lamp niche, the grey rainy light, the uniform and silver chain, and Ramayyan's face. Leave the plain wall above and between their heads clear for two balloons.
fixes.issues: The action is reversed: Nagoji holds the small leaf out, while Ramayyan sits holding a bundle and stylus. The script has Ramayyan holding the leaf where Nagoji can see it. Nagoji's bare left forearm also shows the brand as a round wheel or compass emblem with spokes, a symbol the bible forbids. His ear ornament hangs as a small drop, not a flush stud.

fixes.correction: Frame a medium shot of Ramayyan from across the table, at the eye level of a man seated on the low stool, so that Nagoji's stool and the door are behind the camera and out of frame. Show no empty stool, no open door and no doorway. Ramayyan, seated on his low seat with the barred rainy window and neem tree behind him and the lit lamp niche in the side wall, draws an older bundle of palm leaves out of a small plain wooden box on the seat beside him, its lid raised. The bundle must look clearly older than the fresh bundles on the table: darker brown leaves, edges worn soft, rounded and frayed from handling, tied with a faded pale cord. Keep Ramayyan's face, white cloth, downcast attentive expression, the warm lamp light and the grey window light from this version. Leave the plain wall above and to the right of his head clear for one long balloon.
fixes.issues: Nagoji's stool sits empty in the foreground, and the door behind it stands open onto the rainy courtyard. That reads as if Nagoji has left the room, but he is seated in 9.3 and 9.5, and the door is closed in 9.1 and 9.3. Ramayyan is untying a bundle already in his hands rather than drawing it out. The bundle looks like the newer ones on the table, not visibly older. Ramayyan himself matches his sheet, and the room, lamp niche and rainy window are right.

fixes.correction: Keep this over-the-shoulder composition, the 3-to-1 strip, Ramayyan's face and his flat, factual expression, the closed door at left, the barred rainy window with the neem tree, and the lit lamp niche at right. Fix four things. First, Nagoji sits on a low backless wooden stool, as in the earlier panels. No chair back, rail, posts or finials appear anywhere in the foreground, which shows only the back of his head (topknot, long curly black hair, grey at the temple) and his white-coated shoulders. Second, his ear ornament is a tiny flush gold stud on the lobe, with no ring, hoop or drop. Third, the silver chain of office runs around the back of his neck under his hair and hangs at the front, so only a short stretch shows at the nape and no medallion sits on his back. Fourth, Ramayyan has laid his stylus down and holds in both hands the older bundle from the previous panel: darker brown leaves, edges worn soft and frayed, tied with a faded pale cord. Lower the framing a little so Ramayyan's whole head, with some headroom, sits inside the middle half of the frame height. Leave plain wall clear beside the window and to the right of his head for three balloons.
fixes.issues: Nagoji's ear ornament is a small gold ring through the lobe, not the flush stud the bible and the author's decision require. In the foreground he sits on a chair with a backrest and turned finials. In 9.1 and 9.3 he sits on a low backless stool, and the room direction bans chairs.
